ei.title: Why Scientific Experiments Require Manipulation and Control
ei.subject: 6월_2023 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Why Scientific Experiments Require Manipulation and Control

fullPassage: The fundamental nature of the experimental method is manipulation and control. Scientists manipulate a variable of interest, and see if there's a difference. At the same time, they attempt to control for the potential effects of all other variables. The importance of controlled experiments in identifying the underlying causes of events cannot be overstated. In the real-uncontrolled-world, variables are often correlated. For example, people who take vitamin supplements may have different eating and exercise habits than people who don't take vitamins. As a result, if we want to study the health effects of vitamins, we can't merely observe the real world, since any of these factors (the vitamins, diet, or exercise) may affect health. Rather, we have to create a situation that doesn't actually occur in the real world. That's just what scientific experiments do. They try to separate the naturally occurring relationship in the world by manipulating one specific variable at a time, while holding everything else constant.

The importance of controlled experiments in identifying the underlying causes of events cannot be overstated. In the real-uncontrolled-world, variables are often correlated. For example, people who ④<u>take</u> vitamin supplements may have different eating and exercise habits than people who don't take vitamins. Rather, we have to create a situation that doesn't actually occur in the real world. That's just what scientific experiments do. They try to separate the naturally occurring relationship in the world by manipulating one specific variable at a time, while holding everything else constant.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① method are → method is: 주어의 핵심이 단수 nature(method 전체)이므로 단수동사 is가 맞음
det.analysis:

❌ ② attempt — 'they attempt to control(통제하려 시도한다)'. 복수주어 they에 맞아요.

❌ ③ to control — 'attempt to control(통제하려고)'. attempt 뒤 to부정사라 맞아요.

❌ ④ take — 'people who take vitamin supplements(비타민을 먹는 사람들)'. 복수 people에 맞아요.

det.korean: ③ that don't → that doesn't: 선행사 a situation이 단수이므로 관계절 동사도 단수 doesn't가 맞음

❌ ② correlated — 'variables are often correlated(변수들이 흔히 상관된다)'. be동사 뒤 보어인 과거분사라 맞아요.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ by manipulate → by manipulating: 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사가 와야 하므로 manipulating이 맞음
det.analysis:
❌ ① manipulate — 'Scientists manipulate a variable'. 복수주어에 맞아요.

❌ ② who don't — 'people who don't take vitamins'. 복수 선행사에 맞아요.

❌ ③ observe — 'we can't merely observe(단지 관찰만 할 순 없다)'. 조동사 can't 뒤 동사원형이라 맞아요.

✅ ④ by manipulate — 원문은 by manipulating이에요. 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사가 와야 하므로 'by manipulating one specific variable(한 변수를 조작함으로써)'이 맞아요. by manipulate는 틀려요. ←정답

As a result, if we want to study the health effects of vitamins, we can't merely ②<u>observe</u> the real world, since any of these factors (the vitamins, diet, or exercise) may ③<u>affect</u> health. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① independent → correlated: 통제되지 않은 현실에서 변수들은 흔히 '상관된다(correlated)'가 맞으므로 '독립적인(independent)'은 부적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① independent(독립적인) — 원문은 correlated예요. 뒤이어 '비타민 먹는 사람은 식사·운동 습관도 다르다'는 예가 나오듯, 현실에서는 변수들이 '서로 상관된다'는 것이 핵심이라 '독립적인'은 정반대라 부적절해요. ←정답

❌ ② observe(관찰하다): '현실을 단지 관찰만 할 순 없다' — 맞아요.

❌ ③ affect(영향을 주다): '요인들이 건강에 영향을 줄 수 있다' — 맞아요.

❌ ④ constant(일정한): '나머지는 일정하게 유지' — 맞아요.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② cure → affect: 요인들이 건강에 '영향을 줄(affect)' 수 있다가 맞으므로 '치료하다(cure)'는 부적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① attempt(시도하다): '통제하려 시도한다' — 맞아요.

✅ ② cure(치료하다) — 원문은 affect예요. 비타민·식단·운동 어느 것이든 건강에 '영향을 줄' 수 있어 관찰만으론 안 된다는 흐름이라, '치료하다'는 뜻이 어긋나 부적절해요. ←정답

❌ ③ create(만들다): '현실에 없는 상황을 만들어야 한다' — 맞아요.

❌ ④ separate(분리하다): '자연히 얽힌 관계를 분리하려 한다' — 맞아요.
